Seal of the Crusader: its effect 1 attack speed is offset by a main-hand damage reduction (weapon DPS kept) and a base DPS correction; x1.4 damage done by the spells its dummy affects

Holy Light's heal is instant (its own Spell.dbc cast time is ignored)
Holy Shock needs a target it can assist or attack; an enemy must be in front
MECHANIC_TURN is single-target: a new Turn Undead ends the previous one
Blessing of Light adds its effect amounts to Holy Light (effect 0) and Flash of Light (effect 1) healing taken
Divine Intervention cannot target a flag carrier (23333/23335)
